hero.title: AI That Powers
hero.description: IntelliConvo learns from your website, answers visitor questions instantly, and keeps working long after you've logged off. No training required. Just paste your URL and go live.

features.title: Everything You Need to
features.subtitle: Built for high-traffic websites that demand precision, speed, and zero maintenance overhead.

selfLearningAI.title: Self-Learning AI
selfLearningAI.description: Automatically ingests and learns from your website content, keeping answers accurate as your content evolves.

sub100ms.title: Sub-100ms Responses
sub100ms.description: Vector-search powered retrieval ensures instant, relevant answers. No user left waiting.

multiLanguage.title: Multi-Language
multiLanguage.description: Auto-detect and respond in any language. Your AI speaks to the world, not just English speakers.

voiceText.title: Voice + Text
voiceText.description: Full voice interaction alongside text, making your widget accessible to every type of visitor.

secure.title: Secure by Design
secure.description: AES-256 encryption in transit and at rest. Your data and your visitors' conversations are protected by default.

analytics.title: Deep Analytics
analytics.description: Track conversation flows, sentiment, unanswered questions, and conversion events in real-time.

howItWorks.title: Live in Under
howItWorks.subtitle: From blank canvas to a production-grade AI assistant. No engineering team required.

connect.title: Connect Your Site
connect.body: Enter your URL and our crawler maps every page, building a semantic knowledge base automatically.

tune.title: Tune the Persona
tune.body: Name your assistant, set its tone, define escalation rules. Customize everything to match your brand.

deploy.title: Deploy in Seconds
deploy.body: Copy one line of JavaScript. The widget goes live immediately. No build step, no DevOps required.

useCases.title: Built for
useCases.subtitle: Whether you run a shop, a SaaS, or a content site, IntelliConvo adapts to your visitors and your goals.

ecommerce.headline: Turn Browsers Into Buyers
ecommerce.description: Answer product questions instantly, guide visitors to the right item, and never lose a sale to an unanswered question. Your AI acts as a personal shopper, available 24/7.

saas.headline: Qualify Leads While You Sleep
saas.description: Capture and pre-qualify prospects around the clock. Your AI handles the first conversation so your team stays focused on closing deals.

blogs.headline: Help Readers Find What They Need
blogs.description: Surface your best content contextually. Visitors get instant, relevant answers instead of bouncing away to search engines.

cta.title: Ready to Give Your Website
cta.subtitle: Set up your AI assistant in under 5 minutes. No engineering team required. Just paste one line of code and go live.

footer.tagline: Making websites more intelligent, one conversation at a time.

chatDemo.hello: 👋 Hello! How can I help you today?
chatDemo.demoQ1: What can this chatbot do for me?
chatDemo.demoA1: I answer questions about your products, qualify leads, and support customers 24/7. All trained on your own website content.
chatDemo.demoA2: Under 5 minutes! Paste your URL, we crawl it, and your AI goes live instantly. 🚀

showcase.title: See IntelliConvo
showcase.subtitle: A real look inside the dashboard — from content ingestion and live conversations to full widget customization.

descriptions.dashboard: Get a bird's-eye view of all your connected sites, conversation volume, and performance metrics at a glance.
descriptions.overview: Deep-dive into site-level analytics: message counts, top questions, response quality scores, and engagement trends over time.
descriptions.content: Browse every page and document your AI has learned from. Add, remove, or re-crawl content on demand — no re-training needed.
descriptions.conversations: Review every chat in full detail. Filter by date, rating, or unanswered status, and export transcripts for team review.
descriptions.widget: Customize your widget's colors, position, avatar, and welcome message — with a live preview that updates instantly.
descriptions.management: Manage site settings, embed codes, crawl schedules, and team access from one organized control panel.
